description: This is a test script for a TypeScript SDK agent, written in Python, that spins up a Node.js-based agent process, ensures its proper registration and port listening, and tests its execution via API calls within a testing framework (pytest).

methods.name: int _get_free_port(host: str = "0.0.0.0")
methods.description: Finds and returns a free TCP port on the specified host.

methods.name: run_ts_agent(node_id: str)
methods.description: Asynchronously launches a TypeScript agent subprocess with environment setup and ensures cleanup.

methods.name: _wait_for_registration(http_client, node_id: str, process, timeout: float = 30.0)
methods.description: Polls the agent's registration API until the agent registers or timeout occurs.

methods.name: _wait_for_port_ready(port: int, process, host: str = "127.0.0.1", timeout: float = 15.0)
methods.description: Checks if the agent has opened its HTTP port before proceeding.

methods.name: test_typescript_agent_registers_and_executes(async_http_client)
methods.description: Main test function that verifies the agent registers, is reachable, and executes a command successfully.

ctags.name: _wait_for_port_ready
ctags.pattern: /^async def _wait_for_port_ready(port: int, process, host: str = "127.0.0.1", timeout: float = 15./
ctags.signature: (port: int, process, host: str = "127.0.0.1", timeout: float = 15.0)

ctags.name: _wait_for_registration
ctags.pattern: /^async def _wait_for_registration(http_client, node_id: str, process, timeout: float = 30.0):$/
